tools.name: TaskCreate
tools.description:
Use this tool to create a structured task list for your current coding session. This helps you track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness to the user.
It also helps the user understand the progress of the task and overall progress of their requests.

## When to Use This Tool

Use this tool proactively in these scenarios:

- Complex multi-step tasks - When a task requires 3 or more distinct steps or actions
- Non-trivial and complex tasks - Tasks that require careful planning or multiple operations
- Plan mode - When using plan mode, create a task list to track the work
- User explicitly requests todo list - When the user directly asks you to use the todo list
- User provides multiple tasks - When users provide a list of things to be done (numbered or comma-separated)
- After receiving new instructions - Immediately capture user requirements as tasks
- When you start working on a task - Mark it as in_progress BEFORE beginning work
- After completing a task - Mark it as completed and add any new follow-up tasks discovered during implementation

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Skip using this tool when:
- There is only a single, straightforward task
- The task is trivial and tracking it provides no organizational benefit
- The task can be completed in less than 3 trivial steps
- The task is purely conversational or informational

NOTE that you should not use this tool if there is only one trivial task to do. In this case you are better off just doing the task directly.

## Task Fields

- **subject**: A brief, actionable title in imperative form (e.g., "Fix authentication bug in login flow")
- **description**: What needs to be done
- **activeForm** (optional): Present continuous form shown in the spinner when the task is in_progress (e.g., "Fixing authentication bug"). If omitted, the spinner shows the subject instead.

All tasks are created with status `pending`.

## Tips

- Create tasks with clear, specific subjects that describe the outcome
- After creating tasks, use TaskUpdate to set up dependencies (blocks/blockedBy) if needed
- Check TaskList first to avoid creating duplicate tasks

tools.name: TaskGet
tools.description:
Use this tool to retrieve a task by its ID from the task list.

## When to Use This Tool

- When you need the full description and context before starting work on a task
- To understand task dependencies (what it blocks, what blocks it)
- After being assigned a task, to get complete requirements

## Output

Returns full task details:
- **subject**: Task title
- **description**: Detailed requirements and context
- **status**: 'pending', 'in_progress', or 'completed'
- **blocks**: Tasks waiting on this one to complete
- **blockedBy**: Tasks that must complete before this one can start

## Tips

- After fetching a task, verify its blockedBy list is empty before beginning work.
- Use TaskList to see all tasks in summary form.

Use this tool to list all tasks in the task list.

## When to Use This Tool

- To see what tasks are available to work on (status: 'pending', no owner, not blocked)
- To check overall progress on the project
- To find tasks that are blocked and need dependencies resolved
- After completing a task, to check for newly unblocked work or claim the next available task
- **Prefer working on tasks in ID order** (lowest ID first) when multiple tasks are available, as earlier tasks often set up context for later ones

## Output

- **id**: Task identifier (use with TaskGet, TaskUpdate)
- **subject**: Brief description of the task
- **status**: 'pending', 'in_progress', or 'completed'
- **owner**: Agent ID if assigned, empty if available
- **blockedBy**: List of open task IDs that must be resolved first (tasks with blockedBy cannot be claimed until dependencies resolve)

tools.name: TaskUpdate
tools.description:
Use this tool to update a task in the task list.

## When to Use This Tool

**Mark tasks as resolved:**
- When you have completed the work described in a task
- When a task is no longer needed or has been superseded
- IMPORTANT: Always mark your assigned tasks as resolved when you finish them
- After resolving, call TaskList to find your next task

- ONLY mark a task as completed when you have FULLY accomplished it
- If you encounter errors, blockers, or cannot finish, keep the task as in_progress
- When blocked, create a new task describing what needs to be resolved
- Never mark a task as completed if:
  - Tests are failing
  - Implementation is partial
  - You encountered unresolved errors
  - You couldn't find necessary files or dependencies

**Delete tasks:**
- When a task is no longer relevant or was created in error
- Setting status to `deleted` permanently removes the task

**Update task details:**
- When requirements change or become clearer
- When establishing dependencies between tasks

## Fields You Can Update

- **status**: The task status (see Status Workflow below)
- **subject**: Change the task title (imperative form, e.g., "Run tests")
- **description**: Change the task description
- **activeForm**: Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress (e.g., "Running tests")
- **owner**: Change the task owner (agent name)
- **metadata**: Merge metadata keys into the task (set a key to null to delete it)
- **addBlocks**: Mark tasks that cannot start until this one completes
- **addBlockedBy**: Mark tasks that must complete before this one can start

## Status Workflow

Status progresses: `pending` → `in_progress` → `completed`

Use `deleted` to permanently remove a task.

## Staleness

Make sure to read a task's latest state using `TaskGet` before updating it.

## Examples

Mark task as in progress when starting work:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "status": "in_progress"}
```

Mark task as completed after finishing work:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "status": "completed"}
```

Delete a task:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "status": "deleted"}
```

Claim a task by setting owner:
```json
{"taskId": "1", "owner": "my-name"}
```

Set up task dependencies:
```json
{"taskId": "2", "addBlockedBy": ["1"]}
```

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Yellow Pool — Design Sandbox</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  background: #0c0914;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── SCENE ── */
.scene {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.stars {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: .28;
  pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,216,107,.85) 0 1px, transparent 1.4px),
    radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,220,.5)  0 1px, transparent 1.4px);
  background-size: 97px 97px, 163px 163px;
  background-position: 11px 23px, 71px 61px;
}

/* ── ORB ── */
.orb-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 340px; height: 340px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  perspective: 1000px;
}

.core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 28%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    #1a0e00 0 52%,
    #2a1600 65%,
    rgba(60,36,0,.7) 78%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    0 0 22px #000,
    0 0 60px rgba(180,120,0,.35),
    0 0 130px rgba(140,90,0,.18);
}

.ring {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%; top: 50%;
  width: var(--d); height: var(--d);
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: var(--th) solid transparent;
  transform-origin: center center;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(var(--tilt)) rotateZ(0deg);
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: var(--op);
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Celestial Nexus · Astral Rune Accumulator</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html, body {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
  background: #020208; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: #f1f5f9; user-select: none;
}
canvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: block; }

.hud {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px; z-index: 10;
}
.header { text-align: center; }
.sub-title {
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .3em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #c084fc; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.main-title {
  font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em;
  color: #faf5ff; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(192,132,252,0.5);
}

/* ── Ascension Deck ── */
.ascension-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 80px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none;
}
.tier-text {
  font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .25em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #e9d5ff; font-weight: 700;
}
.tier-resonance {
  font-size: 26px; font-weight: 900; font-family: monospace;
  color: #f3e8ff; text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(192,132,252,0.8);
}

/* ── Command Bar ── */
.controls {
  pointer-events: auto; display: flex; justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 100%;
}
.btn {
  min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px;
  background: rgba(18, 12, 33, 0.85); border: 1.5px solid rgba(192,132,252,0.35);
  border-radius: 12px; color: #e9d5ff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer;
  transition: all .15s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.btn:hover {
  background: #2e1a53; border-color: #d8b4fe; color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(192,132,252,0.45); transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hazard Level Scaling · Time Mastery & Buff Matrix</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html, body {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
  background: #040308; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  color: #f8fafc; user-select: none;
}
canvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: block; }

/* ── Cyber-HUD Layout ── */
.hud {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px; z-index: 10;
}
.header {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%;
}
.brand-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.sub-title { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .35em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffd86b; font-weight: 700; }
.main-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,216,107,0.5); }

/* ── Top-Right Hazard & Time Widget (Universe 25 Spec) ── */
.telemetry-widget {
  pointer-events: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
  background: rgba(14, 10, 20, 0.9); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,216,107,0.4);
  border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}
.tel-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.tel-lbl { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9c93a8; font-weight: 700; }
.tel-val { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; font-family: monospace; color: #fff; }
.hazard-badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; font-family: monospace;
  background: #1e1726; border: 1.5px solid #524124; color: #ffd86b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,216,107,0.3);
}

/* ── Dynamic Milestone Track (Bottom Viewport) ── */
.milestone-deck {
  pointer-events: auto; width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(8, 6, 12, 0.88); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
.track-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.track-title { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffd86b; font-weight: 700; }
.track-next { font-size: 12px; font-family: monospace; color: #38bdf8; font-weight: 700; }

.milestone-bar {
  display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 4px 0;
}
.milestone-node {
  flex: 1; min-width: 95px; min-height: 58px; padding: 8px 10px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s ease;
}
.milestone-node:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-color: #ffd86b; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.milestone-node.unlocked {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,216,107,0.18), rgba(255,216,107,0.04));
  border-color: #ffd86b; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,216,107,0.25);
}
.node-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; font-family: monospace; }
.node-rank { color: #ffd86b; }
.node-hrs { color: #94a3b8; }
.node-buff { font-size: 9px; color: #e2e8f0; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

/* ── Command Bar ── */
.controls {
  pointer-events: auto; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 6px;
}
.btn {
  min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; background: rgba(22, 16, 32, 0.9);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,216,107,0.35); border-radius: 10px; color: #fef08a;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn:hover { background: #38244a; border-color: #ffd86b; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,216,107,0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.btn.active { background: #b45309; border-color: #fde68a; color: #fff; }
</style>
</head>

.trigger-container {

}
canvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: block; }

.hud-layer {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;

  align-items: center; padding: 26px 20px 24px; z-index: 10;
}
.header { text-align: center; }
.sub-title { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .35em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fbbf24; font-weight: 700; }
.main-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(251,191,36,0.35); }

/* ── Top Permanent Reservoir (The Pool) ── */
.pool-vault {
  pointer-events: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  background: rgba(14, 10, 24, 0.9); border: 1.5px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.4);

  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 24px rgba(251,191,36,0.2);
  transition: transform .1s ease, border-color .1s ease;

.pool-vault.absorb { transform: scale(1.05); border-color: #fde047; box-shadow: 0 0 36px rgba(251,191,36,0.7); }
.vault-icon {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fef08a, #ca8a04);

  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: #78350f;

.vault-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.vault-lbl { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .2em; color: #a1a1aa; text-transform: uppercase; }

/* ── Accumulated Staged Hours Badge Positioned Below Block ── */
.staged-time-badge {
  position: absolute; top: calc(50% + 72px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; pointer-events: none;
}
.staged-lbl {
  font-size: 10px; font-family: monospace; letter-spacing: .25em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #64748b; font-weight: 700; transition: color .2s ease;
}
.staged-lbl.charging { color: #f59e0b; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.8); }
.staged-lbl.burst { color: #38bdf8; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(56,189,248,0.8); }

.staged-odometer {
  font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; font-family: 'Consolas', monospace;
  color: #d1d5db; letter-spacing: .08em; transition: all .15s ease;
}
.staged-odometer.charging { color: #fde047; text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(254,240,138,0.8); transform: scale(1.06); }
.staged-odometer.burst {
  color: #fef08a; text-shadow: 0 0 28px #fde047, 0 0 50px rgba(234,179,8,0.8);
  transform: scale(1.12);
}

/* ── Command Bar ── */
.controls { pointer-events: auto; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 100%; max-width: 860px; }
.btn {
  min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; background: rgba(18, 12, 30, 0.9);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.35); border-radius: 12px; color: #fef08a;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .1s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn:hover { background: #2b1845; border-color: #fde047; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(251,191,36,0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); }
